name: technical-writer
description: Write technical prose, PR descriptions and project READMEs, and audit README claims against the repository

interface.shortDescription: Technical prose, pull request descriptions and verified READMEs
interface.longDescription: Choose a format for software prose, write a pull request title and description from its diff, or write and audit a project README. The README audit checks documented commands, formats and quickstart steps against the repository and reports the evidence.
capabilities: Choose the shape of a document from its reader and the moment they read it
Draft a postmortem, runbook, design doc or error message in that shape
Review prose and cite the rule each finding breaks
Keep color, images and links usable without sight
Write a project README and check its examples
Audit a README against the project and report discrepancies
defaultPrompt: Write a runbook from these notes.
Audit this README against the code.
